description: Unit tests for the ResolvedTargetData class in the Chromium project's build system, testing dependency resolution, inheritance of libraries, frameworks, and module dependencies.

classes.name: ResolvedTargetData
classes.description: Class responsible for resolving and providing dependency and linkage information for build targets.

methods.name: GetTargetDeps
methods.description: Retrieves dependencies of a target, categorized by private, public, and data dependencies.

methods.name: GetLinkedLibraries
methods.description: Returns the list of linked libraries for a target.

methods.name: GetLinkedLibraryDirs
methods.description: Returns the list of linked library directories for a target.

methods.name: GetLinkedFrameworks
methods.description: Returns the list of linked frameworks for a target.

methods.name: GetLinkedFrameworkDirs
methods.description: Returns the list of linked framework directories for a target.

methods.name: GetInheritedLibraries
methods.description: Returns libraries inherited through dependencies, respecting dependency types and inheritance rules.

methods.name: GetModuleDepsInformation
methods.description: Provides information about module dependencies for a target.
